search_phytosanitary_products.description: The plant protection products authorised in France (E-Phy), found by what they hold or what they are for: substance ("prosulfocarbe", "glyphosate"), crop as E-Phy names it ("Blé", "Vigne", "Maïs"), target ("pucerons", "désherbage", "mildiou") or product name. Give at least one. Each product comes with its authorisation number, its firm and its substances; with a crop or a target, also the matching usages: dose, days before harvest, untreated buffer from water in metres. total counts every match.

crop.description: Crop, by its French E-Phy label

target.description: Pest, disease or purpose, in French

limit.description: Number of products, 10 by default, 20 at most

get_parcel.description: Everything the datasets know at a point of metropolitan France: commune, cadastral parcel and its area, crop declared to the CAP and the rotation of the last campaigns, yields of the department, selling price and what Lexicon holds about that crop, soil depth and available water, water nearby (distances in metres), zonings, land transactions, the weather of the last 30 days at the nearest station, farms of the commune; the territorial food projects covering the commune; the farming and food of the commune as get_commune gives them (quality signs, organic farming, farms certified HVE, canteens, agricultural schools); and the zones delimited for wines under AOC that hold the point. Use it for any question about a place given by coordinates.

get_crop_history.description: The crops declared to the Common Agricultural Policy at a point of metropolitan France, campaign after campaign (2022 onwards): what was grown there each year. Needs coordinates in degrees (WGS 84).

get_input_price.description: The latest price before tax, in euros, of farm inputs in France: plant protection products (by product name, active substance such as "glyphosate", or authorisation number), fertilisers ("ammonitrate", "urée", "18 46"), seeds ("blé tendre", "luzerne"), non-road diesel ("gazole non routier"). Each result gives the price, its unit (liter, kilogram, ton), the date of the price and how it was obtained (observed, estimated, or an older reference price). Give quantity, in the unit of the price, to get the cost: a dose per hectare gives a cost per hectare. Check price-date and stale: many prices are several years old.

query.description: A few French or English words naming the input

quantity.description: Quantity to cost, in the unit of the price, such as 3 for 3 L/ha

limit.description: Number of prices, 10 by default, 20 at most

get_crop_figures.description: Yields (quintals per hectare, by campaign, 2021 onwards) and selling prices of a crop in France, by department. production takes a few French or English words such as "blé tendre", "tournesol" or "maize"; department is a code such as 17. Without a department, yields are averaged over the departments. Prices are few: many are national quotations (zone France). Each production also comes with documentation, the address of its page on the wiki Triple Performance when it has one: give it to who wants to read about growing or raising it.

search_rd_documents.description: Search the documents of the French agricultural R&D platform (rd-agri.fr): trial reports, technical guides, articles, videos. Put everything in query, as a few short French keywords such as "mildiou vigne bio cuivre". The other arguments are filters that few documents match: leave them out at first, and add one only to narrow down too many results. Each result has a title, a year, a publisher, an excerpt and the address of the source.

production.description: Reference name of a production, as found in /production/productions

pest.description: Pest or disease, by its French label

production_system.description: Only the documents explicitly linked to a production system: organic_farming, conservation_agriculture, sustainable_agriculture or intensive_farming

limit.description: Number of documents, 10 by default, 20 at most

get_commune.description: Everything the datasets know about a French commune, joined in advance: cadastre totals, establishments of every activity, MSA farm chiefs, nearest weather station; and the plant protection products bought there over five years (kilograms of active substance, per hectare of farmland outside grassland, by function and hazard class, the ten substances bought most). These are purchases estimated from sales, not uses: say so. Also its farming and food, each part with a note saying what the figures do not say, to be repeated: quality-signs (areas of AOC/AOP, IGP and IG covering it, with their products; INAO, for information only), organic (operators, farms and organic area year by year, Agence Bio; an area of fewer than three farms is masked and the intercommunality gives the order of magnitude; parcels are counted at the seat of the farm), hve (farms of the HVE directory seated there, a minimum; their names with a member key), canteens (canteens of the national register and the organic share of the purchases they declared; only canteens that declared), agricultural-schools (those of the commune, or the three nearest), territorial-food-projects (PAT covering it).
